sloka: ताडितो माणिभद्रस्य मुकुटे प्राहरद्रणे ।तस्य तेन प्रहारेम मुकुटं पार्श्वमागतम् ।। ७.१५.१४ ॥
transliteration: tāḍito māṇibhadrasya mukuṭe prāharadraṇe ।tasya tena prahārema mukuṭaṁ pārśvamāgatam ।। 7.15.14 ॥

translations.english: Being struck, he then struck Manibhadra's crown in battle, and by that blow, his crown was knocked to the side.
